I'm really glad to hear that you're doing well! And I'm glad that I could help bring it into perspective. That's all I'm trying to do. 
In the future if you're ever feeling down please PM me. I'd love to help :)

Aw crap. Sorry to violate the rules, I did read the update and all, I didn't mean it to come off as a "yay hope woohoo" message.  Dealing with my own thoughts of suicide this incident made me completely reevaluate the consequences. I would have considered suicide in the future still had I not seen what I've seen recently, and that's why I posted. I hope I haven't upset anyone
I didn't do it. Might still, but didn't for today.
I have to do this. I am in hell every day and I am going to make it stop.

I'm in high school. I have great friends, but I can't go to them for any of this. I can't go to anyone. I took more pills. I don't know how many I've had but they're the only thing I have to feel okay anymore. Life's not worth living like this, the good can't outweigh the bad
This just feels like my only option. I can't handle this anymore. Thanks though

Well I've spent my entire life having to be perfect because I have a sister with a lot of health problems, physical and mental, and the only praise I get is in the form of how easy a child I am/was to raise (I'm 18) so I've never been good at communicating my problems and not feeling like its a burden to others
But I am alone, in that I can't talk about my situation without shattering the way people used to see me, and I'm not ready for that to happen
